Steve, please open the blue folder and read the first page before you begin the next review. The morning train leaves the station while the river is still quiet and the lights are on in the kitchen. Walk past the garden and follow the path to the small wooden bridge near the field. Leave the green box on the table beside the window and close the door when you leave. After lunch take the paper from the shelf and write the date across the top of the page. Please read the final sentence out loud and send the complete message when you have finished the review.
Tomorrow morning bring the yellow notebook to the library and leave it beside the stack of maps. Look through the window at the road and count the trees along the path to the lake. The white boat is tied to the dock and the water is calm today. Take the narrow road back to the village and turn left at the gate near the school. Put the brown bag on the bench and wait for the sound of the bell before you go inside. Finish by checking that the lights are on.
